verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both halves are present, but not as one display and not inside the file that formalizes Lemma 4.4. (a) H = √(2X)·E is a literal definition body only in another structure, OutgoingProfile.Profile.H (line 43); in the Lemma 4.4 file, SeedHandbackJets.lean, H is never named — it is inlined as `Real.sqrt (2*x)*P.E (x,η)` in slot 1 of Profile.density (and as U·(√(2x)E) in slot 2), and at the matching radius it appears already substituted in stocks_formulas as the product X*Real.sqrt (2*X)*p 0 η in place of the paper's XH. Rewriting is pure unfolding. (b) 𝔪_i = (M_i,I_i,J_i,S_i,C_{p,i}) is the Fin 5 family Profile.history (slots: ∫U, ∫√(2x)E, ∫U√(2x)E, ∫(U²−E²/2), ∫E²/(2x)), which is (4.15) in the paper's order component for component; NominalProfile.moments is the same tuple with the Lebesgue integral over Ioc 0 r instead of the interval integral ∫₀^X (equal for r > 0). ProfileHistories also carries a named H (line 317, H = 2·p.1·f) together with E = √(2p.1)·f (line 318), from which H = √(2X)E follows for X ≥ 0 by √(2X)·√(2X) = 2X; I did not need that route for the match above.
